limits: Record counts mix database/reference/study/benchmark levels and are not counts of unique independent datasets or biological observations.
Curated means source-backed metadata, with verification level stated. It does not mean full data-file validation.
Imported assets remain candidates unless explicitly reconciled with inspected original data.
Neither global exhaustiveness nor world-largest status is established.

bounded_file_audit.coverage_limit: Selected files/queries only. Reference and index records are not experimental training observations; T-psi-C includes independently audited linked studies.
